entities.summary: John Paul Kotter is the Konosuke Matsushita Professor of Leadership, Emeritus at the Harvard Business School, an author, and the founder of Kotter International, a management consulting firm based in Seattle and Boston. He is a thought leader in business, leadership, and change.
